warning.titlePre: Jaguar F-Pace D200 Timing Chain & Injector Wear
paragraphs: F-Pace D200 models with the Ingenium AJ200D 2.0-litre diesel engine commonly show timing chain stretch and injector seal wear over time. This is a well-documented pattern across the Ingenium diesel family, shared with F-Pace's platform siblings including the XE, XF and Velar. We replace the timing chain components, injector seals, EGR and gaskets as standard on every AJ200D rebuild.
warning.source: Source: established Ingenium diesel pattern, per VRF-jaguar-f-pace.md and G-BRF-Jaguar.md.
